blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models recover geometry at high fidelity, yet inference memory constraints keep them from processing long sequences natively. Current streaming systems work around this limit with sliding-window chunking, which introduces severe monocular scale ambiguity. Resolving this ambiguity requires Sim(3) registration that stays accurate and efficient under outlier contamination. We introduce Sim(3)-TurboReg, which reformulates the compatibility graph construction of TurboReg by replacing absolute distance constraints with a strict Tri-Scale Consistency (TSC) criterion. Our analysis shows that TSC suppresses both mismatching and coordinate-distortion outliers. We integrate the resulting solver into existing streaming systems and obtain high-fidelity, kilometer-scale reconstruction for feed-forward models. On controlled unknown-scale registration at 90% outliers, ours matches RANSAC accuracy with 92.5% lower median latency. In DA3-Streaming on KITTI, ours improves mean ATE RMSE by 22.2% and reduces mean end-to-end time by 16.6%. Code: https://github.com/ivan-zzj/Sim3-TurboReg
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D地基模型在高忠诚度下恢复几何学,而推论内存限制却使它们无法本土地处理长序列. 目前的流线系统围绕这个极限工作,采用滑动-窗口分块,这带来了严重的单相尺度模糊. 解决这一模糊性需要Sim(3)登记,在外部污染下保持准确而高效。 我们引入了Sim(3)-TurboReg,它通过用严格的三相一致性(TSC)标准来取代绝对距离限制来重构TurboReg的相容图构造. 我们的分析表明,海训方案既抑制不匹配现象,又抑制了协调-扭曲输出器。 我们把结果的解析器整合到现有的流体系统中,并获得高精度,千米尺度的重建,用于饲料推进模型. 在超过90%的受控未知规模登记中, 我们的RANSAC精度与92.5%的中位点相符。 在DA3-Streaming on KITTI中,我们的ATE RMSE改进了22.2%,平均端到端时间缩短了16.6%. 代码:https://github.com/ivan-zzj/Sim3-TurboReg (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] are now a standard approach to visual geometry, recovering dense pointmaps and camera poses from uncalibrated images in a single forward pass. However, their joint attention mechanisms impose memory costs that grow quadratically with the input length [ 4 ] , causing out-of-memory failures on sequences beyond a few hundred frames on a single GPU [ 5 ] . This computational ceiling prevents their deployment on the continuous, kilometer-scale video streams required for autonomous driving [ 6 ] and large-scale mapping [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D地基模型[1,2,3]现在是视觉几何学的标准方法,从单个前传中从未校正的图像中恢复出密集点图和相机所呈现出. 然而,他们的联合关注机制强加了内存成本,与输入长度相差四倍地增长[4],导致单个GPU上超过几百帧的序列出现出镜故障[5]. 这种计算上限使其无法部署在自动驱动[6]和大规模绘图[7]所需的连续、千米尺度的视频流上。

blocks.en:
The prevailing workaround for this memory bottleneck is a sliding-window strategy [ 8 , 9 ] : partitioning a long video into overlapping chunks, processing each independently, and aligning the resulting local reconstructions into a coherent global map [ 8 ] .
However, without metric priors, feed-forward models reconstruct each chunk in its own local coordinate system with an unconstrained scale [ 1 , 2 ] .
This inherent scale ambiguity systematically invalidates standard rigid SE(3) registration, which relies on absolute distance preservation.
Consequently, to fuse these independent chunks, the alignment task is raised from SE(3) to the more challenging Sim(3) domain [ 10 , 11 ] .
Fig. 1 illustrates the resulting global reconstruction and compares local chunk alignment using IRLS and Sim(3)-TurboReg.
blocks.zh:
这个记忆瓶颈的普遍工作是滑入窗口策略[8,9]:将一长段视频分割成相重叠的块,分别独立处理,并将由此而来的地方重建调整为连贯的全球地图[8].
然而,如果没有计量前兆,饲料前导模型将每个块重建在自己的局部坐标系统中,其尺度不受限制。
这种固有的尺度模糊性系统地使标准僵硬的SE(3)注册失效,而SE(3)注册依赖于绝对的距离保全.
因此,为了将这些独立的块装入引信,调整任务从SE(3)提高到更具挑战性的Sim(3)域 [10,11]。
图1用IRLS和Sim(3)-TurboReg来说明由此产生的全球重建,并比较局部块对齐.

blocks.en:
Robust Sim(3) solvers such as TEASER++ [ 12 ] estimate scale, rotation, and translation despite incorrect correspondences, but accuracy and runtime depend on outlier rate and problem size.
Conversely, sampling-based approaches (e.g., RANSAC [ 13 ] + Umeyama [ 11 ] ) demand excessive iterations to filter outliers, failing to guarantee deterministic solutions.
While recent graph-based methods [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] achieve robustness and computational efficiency, their reliance on absolute distance invariance limits them to SE(3) registration.
blocks.zh:
强大的Sim(3)解决器,如TEASER++ [12] 估计尺度,旋转,以及翻译,尽管函证不正确,但准确性和运行时间取决于超出率和问题大小.
反之,基于抽样的方法(例如RANSAC[13] + Umeyama[11])要求过量的迭代来过滤出站点,未能保证确定性的解决办法.
虽然最近的以图表为基础的方法[14、15、16]实现了稳健性和计算效率,但它们对绝对距离变化的依赖使其限于SE(3)登记。

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we show a key insight that state-of-the-art graph-based SE(3) estimators [ 14 , 16 , 17 ] can be adapted to Sim(3) registration by changing how their compatibility graph is built.
Building on this, we introduce Sim(3)-TurboReg , an approach that replaces the absolute distance constraints of the original TurboReg [ 14 ] with a strict Tri-Scale Consistency (TSC) criterion.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , TSC combines one edge scale and two endpoint local scales to assess correspondence compatibility.
The resulting pipeline (Fig. 2 ) handles both general point cloud matches and the outlier distributions in streaming systems.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们展示了一个关键的见解,即最先进的以图为基础的SE(3)估计器[14,16,17]可以通过改变其相容图的构建方式来适应Sim(3)的注册.
在此基础上,我们引入了Sim(3)-TurboReg,这种方法用严格的三相一致性(TSC)标准来取代原涡轮Reg[14]的绝对距离限制.
如图2所示,海生委将一个边缘尺度和两个端点局部尺度结合起来,以评估函相兼容性.
由此产生的管线(图2)既能处理一般点云匹配,又能处理流出系统中的出站分布.

blocks.en:
Unlike general point cloud registration, where feature matching techniques inevitably introduce mismatching outliers from incorrect associations, streaming systems that use feed-forward networks with sliding-window chunks [ 9 ] extract correspondences directly from overlapping frames after confidence filtering.
Since these correspondences originate from identical pixels, their matching relationships are correct by construction.
However, dynamics or depth artifacts introduce coordinate-distortion outliers: identities remain correct, but their coordinates no longer follow the common scene transformation.
Fig. 3 contrasts incorrect correspondence identities with coherent coordinate distortion.
We then analyze why TSC suppresses mismatching outliers super-linearly by minimizing false-pass probabilities, and rejects coordinate-distortion outliers by exploiting the scale drift caused by mixed dynamic-static neighborhoods.
blocks.zh:
与一般点云注册不同的是,特征匹配技术不可避免地引入了不正确关联的不匹配输出器,流出系统使用有滑动-窗口块的向导网络[9]在信任过滤后直接从相重叠的帧取出函证.
由于这些通信来源于相同的像素,因此它们的匹配关系通过构建是正确的.
然而,动态或深度文物引入了坐标-扭曲出站器:身份仍然正确,但其坐标不再跟随共同的场景变化.
图3将错误的函证身份与连贯的坐标扭曲作对比。
然后我们分析为什么TSC通过将假通概率降到最低来抑制超线外的不匹配现象,并且通过利用混合动态-静态社区造成的规模漂移来拒绝协调-扭曲外接者。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1. We propose Sim(3)-TurboReg, establishing a robust and efficient framework for Sim(3) registration by reformulating the compatibility graph construction of the original TurboReg with a strict TSC criterion. 2. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that TSC is effective against both mismatching and coordinate-distortion outliers. 3. We achieve a better accuracy–efficiency trade-off than prior robust Sim(3) solvers on unknown-scale registration, and as a drop-in backend improve the accuracy–runtime trade-off of streaming systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: 1. 我们提议Sim(3)-TurboReg,通过重新制定以严格的海训标准为原始涡轮螺旋桨的相容性图表构造,为Sim(3)的登记建立一个健全而有效的框架。 2. 我们提供了一项理论分析,表明海训方案对不匹配和协调-扭曲输出器都是有效的。 3. 我们比以往强健的Sim(3)解析器在未知规模的登记上实现更好的准确性-效率取舍,作为滴入后端提高流出系统的准确性-运行时间取舍。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Feed-Forward 3D Foundation Models
blocks.zh: Feed-Forward 三维基础模型

blocks.en:
Recent advances in visual geometry are driven by feed-forward models that infer 3D structure directly from images.
On the monocular side, Depth Anything [ 18 ] and Metric3D [ 19 ] provide strong single-image geometry predictions, where Metric3D explicitly targets zero-shot metric-scale depth and surface normals across diverse camera settings.
Beyond single images, DUSt3R [ 1 ] introduces dense pointmap regression for unconstrained reconstruction from an uncalibrated image pair.
MASt3R [ 2 ] improves correspondence accuracy by augmenting DUSt3R with a dense local-feature head trained via an additional matching loss.
Extending this paradigm to larger view sets, VGGT [ 3 ] jointly predicts pointmaps and camera poses from up to hundreds of views via Transformer aggregation.
Depth Anything 3 [ 20 ] extracts spatially consistent geometry from arbitrary visual inputs regardless of known camera poses.
To reduce designated reference view sensitivity, π 3 \pi^{3} [ 21 ] adopts a permutation-equivariant formulation.
For continuous streams, CUT3R [ 22 ] updates a persistent recurrent state with each observation for online reconstruction.
Although these models provide exceptional geometry, GPU memory severely limits long continuous sequences.
Generalizing them to streaming continuous video reconstruction remains challenging.

blocks.en: II-B Streaming and Large-Scale Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 二-B 流和大规模重建

blocks.en:
Classical SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) systems like ORB-SLAM2 [ 23 ] , ORB-SLAM3 [ 24 ] , and LDSO [ 25 ] provide robust trajectory estimation.
They typically require camera intrinsics and sensor extrinsics to build sparse maps from keypoints or high-gradient pixels.
Learning-based systems like DROID-SLAM [ 8 ] , DPVO [ 26 ] , and DPV-SLAM [ 27 ] improve robustness in challenging scenarios.
MASt3R-SLAM [ 28 ] integrates MASt3R [ 2 ] into an online dense SLAM system featuring global optimization and loop closure.
VGGT-Long [ 9 ] uses a chunk-and-align strategy with confidence weighting, IRLS-based [ 29 ] alignment, and a lightweight loop-closure module.
S-MUSt3R [ 30 ] employs MUSt3R-style [ 31 ] priors in a similar segment-and-align pipeline adding segment-level loop detection and pose-graph optimization.
LONG3R [ 32 ] maintains recurrent spatio-temporal memory, while LongStream [ 33 ] introduces gauge-decoupled streaming geometry for extremely long sequences.
LASER [ 34 ] resolves cross-window scale misalignment via training-free layer-wise scale alignment.
Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 20 ] provides DA3-Streaming [ 35 ] for memory-efficient chunked inference on extended videos.
Across these systems, identity mismatches and structured geometric distortions (e.g., dynamic objects or depth artifacts) often compromise cross-window constraints.
This difficulty necessitates robust Sim(3) alignment methods.

blocks.en: II-C Robust Registration and Similarity Estimation
blocks.zh: II-C 强有力的登记和类似性估计

blocks.en:
Point cloud registration estimates geometric transformations from putative correspondences corrupted by noise and outliers.
RANSAC [ 13 ] improves robustness via minimal-set sampling, though runtime grows rapidly with low inlier ratios.
Probabilistic methods like CPD [ 36 ] and GMMReg [ 37 ] formulate registration as density alignment, tolerating moderate noise but degrading under high outlier rates.
Beyond these estimators, robust pipelines explicitly prune outliers before transformation fitting.
Graph-based methods build correspondence compatibility graphs to extract self-consistent subsets.
SC 2 -PCR [ 16 ] incorporates second-order spatial compatibility.
Clique-based formulations select mutually consistent correspondences via clique discovery or graph-search strategies like MAC [ 17 ] and FastMAC [ 38 ] .
TurboReg [ 14 ] accelerates consistent-clique search via guided exploration.
However, these criteria primarily target SE(3) settings preserving absolute inter-point distances.
Under global scale changes, distances scale uniformly, invalidating absolute distance checks.
In Sim(3) registration, Umeyama [ 11 ] provides a closed-form least-squares solution for clean correspondences.
TEASER++ [ 12 ] improves robustness via a certifiable formulation decoupling scale, rotation, and translation under a truncated least-squares objective.

CPD[36]和GMMReg[37]等概率法将登记确定为密度对齐,容忍中度噪音,但在高外速下降低。
除了这些估算器外,强力管道在改造前显然有外源。

然而,这些标准主要针对SE(3)设置,保留绝对点间距离.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 summarizes Sim(3)-TurboReg.
We first define the Sim(3) setting and two outlier modes in Section III-A .
Sim(3)-TurboReg then proceeds in three stages:
(i) compatibility graph construction based on TSC (Section III-B ),
(ii) TurboClique solver with scale-aware degeneracy check (Section III-C ),
and (iii) closed-form Sim(3) estimation with global inlier scoring (Section III-D ).
Finally, Section III-E explains why this design suppresses both outlier types.

blocks.en:
Results. Table I pools all models and seeds per outlier rate.
The pooled means are most informative about how each baseline breaks.
RANSAC-1K fails catastrophically at 90 % 90\% outliers (80 of 320 trials): at inlier ratio 0.1 0.1 a three-point sample is all-inlier with probability ≈ 10 − 3 \approx 10^{-3} , so the 10 3 10^{3} -iteration cap is simply exhausted; only the adaptive variant always returns an estimate, at 13 × 13\times our median latency.
FGR-Sim3 † is the fastest but degrades earliest, because its continuation scheme reweights correspondences yet never isolates a mutually consistent subset, so once outliers dominate, the objective itself is misleading.
TEASER++ fails in a characteristic order: the scale branch degrades first ( e s = 14.3 e_{s}=14.3 at 80 % 80\% ), and rotation follows at 90 % 90\% ( e R = 121.3 ∘ e_{R}=121.3^{\circ} ).
Decoupled scale estimation is thus the weak link under extreme contamination—exactly the quantity that TSC constrains three times per edge.
Ours is the only method besides RANSAC-1min that returns an estimate on every trial at every rate, matching its accuracy (within 0.004 ∘ 0.004^{\circ} in e R e_{R} ) at 92.5 % 92.5\% lower median latency.
Its runtime is also nearly flat in the outlier rate ( 0.70 0.70 ms at 60 % 60\% vs. 0.61 0.61 ms at 90 % 90\% ): TSC rejects contamination before search, so more outliers mean cheaper graph pruning rather than more hypotheses—the opposite of sampling-based scaling.

blocks.en:
Ablations. Table II varies one factor at a time on the same 1,280 1{,}280 inputs, and the failure pattern mirrors the method’s logic.
Disabling TSC is catastrophic (910 failures): the graph becomes almost complete, so pivots land on outlier-dominated cliques whose hypotheses attract no inlier votes.
Node scales must be robust and local at once: replacing the histogram reduction with a union median occasionally lets a distorted neighborhood shift the node scale (2 failures), k = 5 k=5 makes node scales too noisy ( e R e_{R} up 69 % 69\% ), and k = 20 k=20 mixes unrelated structures until local consensus breaks (1 failure).
The risk of the tolerance is one-sided: tightening to τ = 0.05 \tau=0.05 costs nothing, but loosening to τ = 0.20 \tau=0.20 passes enough inconsistent edges to cause 5 failures—a permissive graph is more dangerous than a sparse one, because clique search trusts edge scores.
Post-refinement matters ( e R e_{R} 0.577 ∘ 0.577^{\circ} without it), while a weighted variant adds nothing, indicating the voted inlier set is already clean.
Second-order scoring and the degeneracy filter leave every estimate unchanged at N = 100 N=100 ; they matter at streaming scale (Section IV-B ), where N N is two orders of magnitude larger.

Ablation Studies. Table V varies system-level choices on KITTI and TUM RGB-D.
Two patterns stand out.
First, accuracy is far more sensitive on KITTI than on TUM: across the tolerance, k k , and τ in \tau_{\mathrm{in}} rows the TUM mean stays within 0.003 0.003 m, while KITTI swings by up to 7 7 m—outdoor depth ranges make local scale consensus noisier, so KITTI rewards stricter τ \tau , smaller k k , and stricter τ in \tau_{\mathrm{in}} , whereas indoor scenes saturate TSC well before these knobs matter.
Second, chunk size is the only genuine accuracy–latency trade-off: 60/30 cuts KITTI time by a third and even improves KITTI ATE, since shorter chunks drift less per alignment, but it degrades TUM, where sparser overlaps weaken the constraint chain.
The shaded defaults sit between these regimes, so τ \tau and k k act as dataset-level knobs rather than per-sequence tuning.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Sim(3)-TurboReg, a robust and efficient Sim(3) registration solver built on a strict TSC criterion that suppresses both mismatching and coordinate-distortion outliers.
On controlled unknown-scale registration at 90% outliers, the CPU variant matches RANSAC accuracy with 92.5 % 92.5\% lower median latency.
In DA3-Streaming on KITTI, the proposed backend improves mean ATE by 22.2 % 22.2\% and reduces mean end-to-end time by 16.6 % 16.6\% .
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Sim(3)-TurboReg,这是一个强大而高效的Sim(3)注册解答器,它建立在严格的海训标准之上,它抑制了不匹配和协调-扭曲输出器。
CPU的变体在90%的出站点上,在受控的未知规模的登记上,与RANSAC的精确度相匹配,低中位纬度为92.5%-92.5-%.
在KITTI上的DA3-Streaming中,拟议的后端改进了22.2%的ATE,将平均端到端时间减少了16.6% 16.6%。
